Macros and thread-local state for racesan instrumentation of shared-memory concurrent algorithms.

# Purpose
`fd_racesan_target.h` defines the target-side interface for racesan instrumentation in shared memory concurrent code. It includes the `fd_racesan_hook` macro, which records a named hook point with file and line information when `FD_HAS_RACESAN` is enabled, and expands to nothing when racesan is disabled. The file also declares the thread-local pointer `fd_racesan_g`, which holds the per-thread racesan state used by the instrumentation.
